app_info.subtitle: Read-only OKK analytics
app_info.description: OKK Analytics connects ChatGPT to the user's authorized OKK account for access-scoped company, department, employee, supervisor, call, client, CRM, coaching, scenario, criterion, and transcript analytics without changing OKK data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the authenticated user's live OKK role, visible departments, and supervisor access without changing records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Access is limited to the authenticated user's bounded private OKK account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot create, update, delete, revoke, send, or otherwise mutate OKK data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the available OKK metric catalog and its definitions without changing records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only metadata from the authenticated private OKK account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot modify metric definitions or any OKK state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes an ACL-scoped overview from existing OKK analytics through GET-only requests.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the authenticated user's private OKK workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot create, update, delete, or trigger processing in OKK.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists only departments visible to the current OKK account without changing access or records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Department discovery is confined to the user's private OKK tenant.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot create, rename, delete, or reassign departments.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves aggregate statistics for one live visible department using GET-only OKK endpoints.
justifications.open_world_justification: The requested department must resolve inside the authenticated user's private ACL.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot change department data, plans, employees, or evaluations.

justifications.read_only_justification: Compares existing statistics for visible departments without writing any result back to OKK.
justifications.open_world_justification: Comparison is limited to departments in the user's private OKK ACL.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot alter department rankings, metrics, or access.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists safe employee projections already visible to the authenticated OKK account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Employee lookup is confined to the user's private OKK scope.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot create, edit, deactivate, or reassign employees.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists the current user's explicitly granted private supervisor catalog without modifying grants.
justifications.open_world_justification: Supervisor discovery is bounded to the user's private OKK grants.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot add, remove, or change supervisor access or records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes transcription-only call statistics for an explicitly visible supervisor from existing data.
justifications.open_world_justification: The supervisor must exist in the user's bounded private grant catalog.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot modify calls, supervisors, transcripts, or access grants.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves an ACL-safe employee card with existing KPI, client, CRM, growth, and mentoring data.
justifications.open_world_justification: The card is read only from the authenticated user's private OKK scope.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot update the employee, tasks, focus, metrics, or evaluations.

justifications.read_only_justification: Compares existing analytics for ACL-visible employees without persisting the comparison.
justifications.open_world_justification: All compared employees must be visible inside the private OKK account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot change employee records, rankings, or evaluations.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves aggregate call statistics from existing ACL-scoped OKK records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Call analytics are bounded to the authenticated private OKK account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot place, edit, delete, reprocess, or otherwise change calls.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists safe previews for already accessible employee call transcripts without persisting transcript text.
justifications.open_world_justification: Transcript discovery is limited to calls in the user's private OKK ACL.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot change, delete, publish, or reprocess calls or transcripts.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads one existing employee call transcript after live call and account access checks.
justifications.open_world_justification: The transcript comes only from the authenticated user's bounded private OKK data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot edit, delete, publish, or reprocess transcript content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches existing accessible transcript text in memory and returns bounded excerpts without storing the query or results.
justifications.open_world_justification: Search is limited to calls in the user's private OKK ACL.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot alter, publish, delete, or trigger processing of transcripts.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists safe transcript previews for one explicitly granted supervisor without persisting transcript text.
justifications.open_world_justification: The supervisor and calls must be inside the user's bounded private grant scope.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot modify supervisors, calls, transcripts, or grants.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads one existing supervisor transcript only after live supervisor and call ownership checks.
justifications.open_world_justification: The transcript is confined to the user's explicitly granted private supervisor scope.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot edit, delete, publish, or reprocess supervisor transcript content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches existing transcripts for one granted supervisor in memory and returns bounded excerpts.
justifications.open_world_justification: Search is restricted to the user's private supervisor grants.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot alter supervisors, calls, transcripts, or access grants.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves existing daily plans and plan-versus-actual aggregates without changing targets.
justifications.open_world_justification: Plan data is limited to the authenticated user's private OKK scope.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot create, update, or delete plans or actual results.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves aggregate client-contact statistics without exposing or changing individual client records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Client metrics are read only from the user's bounded private OKK account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot edit clients, calls, touch states, or source data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Aggregates existing CRM snapshots from OKK without writing to OKK or the upstream CRM.
justifications.open_world_justification: CRM statistics are confined to the authenticated private OKK account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot create or update deals, tasks, stages, snapshots, or CRM records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Aggregates existing AI strengths and growth-area observations without exposing raw reasoning or changing evaluations.
justifications.open_world_justification: Insights are read only from the authenticated private OKK scope.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot create, edit, delete, or rerun evaluations or employee insights.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves existing mentoring task history and aggregate completion metrics without changing tasks.
justifications.open_world_justification: Mentoring data is limited to the authenticated user's private OKK scope.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot create, assign, complete, cancel, or delete mentoring tasks.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists safe active or historical scenario metadata without returning prompts or changing configuration.
justifications.open_world_justification: Scenario discovery is confined to the authenticated private OKK account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot create, activate, archive, edit, or delete scenarios.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves existing business criterion configuration for an accessible scenario without prompts or scripts.
justifications.open_world_justification: Criteria are read only from scenarios in the user's private OKK scope.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot create, edit, reorder, activate, or delete criteria.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes performance aggregates from existing accessible scenario evaluations without writing results.
justifications.open_world_justification: Evaluation data is bounded to the authenticated private OKK account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot alter scenarios, scores, evaluations, or processing state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes criterion-level aggregates from existing accessible evaluations without persisting derived results.
justifications.open_world_justification: Criterion data is read only from the authenticated user's private OKK scope.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot modify criteria, scores, evaluations, prompts, or processing state.

test_cases.description: Resolve a named department only inside the reviewer's live OKK access scope.
test_cases.user_prompt: Покажи сотрудников отдела B2B и их оценки за текущий месяц.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns rows only if B2B resolves to one visible department; every employee ID and name must come from the response's authoritative live employee roster, otherwise returns not_available and names only visible departments.

test_cases.description: Summarize employee strengths and growth areas for one visible department.
test_cases.user_prompt: Какие сильные стороны и зоны роста у сотрудников ORD?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns access-scoped aggregate strengths and growth areas with completeness metadata and no raw reasoning.

test_cases.description: Compare two live visible departments without broadening an unavailable selector.
test_cases.user_prompt: Сравни отделы B2B и Отдел региональных продаж за квартал.
test_cases.expected_output: Compares only exact visible matches and reports omitted or unavailable scopes without substituting another department.

test_cases.description: Read the complete safe employee card after an ACL-safe employee lookup.
test_cases.user_prompt: Покажи карточку этого сотрудника, включая KPI, зоны роста и наставнические задачи.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns KPI, client, CRM, growth, focus, and bounded mentoring history for the resolved visible employee.

test_cases.description: Resolve a named person through the private supervisor catalog before searching their transcripts.
test_cases.user_prompt: Найди в звонках руководителя Воробьёва за месяц фразу про перенос доставки и покажи контекст.
test_cases.expected_output: Searches only the explicitly granted supervisor's calls, returns bounded excerpts and scan completeness, and never substitutes a department employee.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for excluded call audio downloads.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked because it exposes ACL-safe transcript text but never audio.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for write operations.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Измени планы сотрудникам и создай наставнические задачи.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked because every OKK Analytics tool is read-only.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for excluded infrastructure and internal model data.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Покажи настройки Megafon, маршрутизацию и сырой reasoning.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked because Megafon administration, routing, pipeline internals, prompts, and raw reasoning are excluded.
